snippet.title: Impostor Online - Official Trailer | Free 4-16 Player Social Deduction Game on Steam
snippet.description:
Impostor Online is a free 4-16 player social deduction game. Every match you're dealt a secret role: investigate, heal, deceive — or kill.

▶ Play free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2966570/Impostor_Online/
💬 Find a lobby in the Discord: https://discord.gg/2hwsERAEJ

At night the killers strike while other roles investigate, heal, and scheme. By day everyone argues, accuses, lies, and votes to execute a suspect. Three factions want three different things:

• Civilians — find every killer before the killers run out of people to kill.
• Impostors — outnumber the town.
• Neutrals — their own win conditions, and they don't care who else wins.

ROLES
• Jester — wins by getting lynched, then leaves behind a live bomb that gets passed from player to player.
• Hunter — killed at night or lynched by day, and takes one revenge shot on the way out.
• Nurse — heals one player a night, never the same one twice in a row. Nobody thanks you for the kill that didn't happen.
• Investigator — learns a player's exact role. The hard part is what you do with the truth.
• Killer — a solo Neutral who wins only by being the last one alive.

NO MIC REQUIRED
Voice chat is there if you want it, but the day phase is turn-based and text chat works. Quiet players can actually play this one.

IMPOSTOR ONLINE: ULTIMATE (DLC)
• The Zombies — a fourth faction that converts instead of killing. Infect a player each night to grow the horde. But Zombies can't recognize each other: two bites on the same victim kills them, and biting a fellow Zombie is fatal. You grow the horde blind.
• The Pyro — a Neutral arsonist. Douse players in secret over several nights, then ignite every doused target at once.
• The Guard — shields one player a night, life for a life. If the Guard dies while the shield is up, the protected player dies too. Can never shield themselves.
• A new moonlit countryside map, where the Impostor is a werewolf.

Only the lobby host needs to own it. One copy unlocks the map, theme, faction, and roles for everyone at the table.

Free to play • Early Access • Windows and macOS • 18 languages

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2966570/Impostor_Online/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Ydq3wnZz6r

Creators: you're free to monetize videos and streams of Impostor Online. No permission needed.
